pages.text: Matching full set + $(k:key.tutorial_mod.dash): 20 base energy, up to 3.5 blocks, no skill cooldown. Dash moves horizontally, even when looking down.$(br2)$(k:key.tutorial_mod.blink): 40 base energy, up to 8 blocks along your aim, no skill cooldown.$(br2)Walls, liquids, world borders and unloaded chunks stop movement. Blocked casts show a message and spend no energy. One successful movement per tick and server packet limits remain for safety.
